header.name: Markov Decision Processes
header.description: Dynamic programming techniques are usefully applied in dynamic models of economics, game theory, operations research and engineering. This course develops the Bellman's principle of optimality in some prominent formulations of the dynamic programming model with a finite/countable state space and discrete time. Some leading applications are discussed as illustrations of the solution methodology.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to formulate a dynamic programming model.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to analyze the optimality conditions in some prominent formulations of dynamic programming model.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to workout some leading applications of the dynamic programming model.
